meta.layout: Coefficient matrices are k x n (rows: const, then lag 1 block in variable order, ..., lag p block; columns: equations), y_t = B'x_t + u_t. Matrices are row-major nested lists.

description: (d) Hierarchical posterior by BVAR's random-walk Metropolis-Hastings on the natural scale of h (target log p(Y | h) + log p(h), truncated to the bounds), one (B, Sigma) draw from the conjugate posterior per stored iteration. Quantiles (R type 7 = numpy 'linear') of the pooled chains with Monte Carlo standard errors. forecast: one path per stored draw with chol(Sigma) noise; forecast_bvar_native: BVAR's predict() (buggy noise).

settings.mcse: max(batch-quantile, delta-method (sparsity x batch-means SE of the indicator), between-chain); batches per chain: 25

forecast.noise: chol(Sigma) z, one path per stored MH draw

forecast_bvar_native.noise: BVAR predict(): Sigma %*% z (covariance Sigma^2 instead of Sigma; BVAR bug). Reference only; do not use as a target.
